    The chain of a good walk (Fischbacher, proof of Lemma 5.2, last step) #

    The morphisms t₀, s₀, t₁, s₁, … of a zigzag walk (segMors) form a chain starting with a valley once all values are nonzero, consecutive peaks are incomparable and consecutive valleys are incomparable (isChain_segMors). For a good walk whose t-paths have nonzero values this is a chain from the first peak to a point of w (ZWalk.Good.isChain).
